verdict.rationale: Jitsu offers self-hosting (full data ownership) and mentions DPA/SCC + SOC2 compliance, which implies some control over where/how data is stored, but there is no explicit retention-policy setting or data-deletion API/feature documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: documented retention window controls, a delete/erase-user-data API or UI action, and any GDPR-style right-to-be-forgotten workflow.
